entry.title: New: dsh-task-runner
entry.summary: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option. Exact install spec: github:jing-hy/dsh-task-runner. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
